sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; SkillGate was recommended, with SPADE and MobileWorldSafety as pivots.
Read arXiv API, abstract page, HTML, TeX source, appendix, GitHub README, operations guide, method code, and Hugging Face model/assets metadata.
Verified clean-oracle utility, identity-span attribution, disjoint task/selector weights, custom GRPO loss, and profile gates in the released repository.
Preserved limits on single-run evidence, oracle-skill supervision, abstention credit, frontier reference comparability, and pass@4 bootstrap uncertainty.
